code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the full constant-color separator; the panels may be side-by-side or stacked.
    split = None
    for i in range(1, w - 1):
        color = grid[0][i]
        if all(row[i] == color for row in grid) and sum(row.count(color) for row in grid) == h:
            if i == w - i - 1:
                split = ('vertical', i)
                break
    if split is None:
        for i in range(1, h - 1):
            color = grid[i][0]
            if all(v == color for v in grid[i]) and sum(row.count(color) for row in grid) == w:
                if i == h - i - 1:
                    split = ('horizontal', i)
                    break
    orientation, i = split
    if orientation == 'vertical':
        a = [row[:i] for row in grid]
        b = [row[i + 1:] for row in grid]
    else:
        a = grid[:i]
        b = grid[i + 1:]
    common = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    mismatch = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if x == y else mismatch for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
'''
